premises: HS− weakens the initial oxide passive film on Type 316 SS
At low Cl− (<0.001 M), HS− promotes formation of a protective sulfide film (MoSx, FeS2)
This sulfide film enables rapid re-passivation and inhibits pitting
Mo in the alloy is crucial for forming the protective molybdenum sulfide film
The beneficial effect is lost at higher Cl− concentrations
